explained.headline: European divisions grow over Russia sanctions and Ukraine support

happened.text: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed banning Russian athletes from competing under their own flag within the European Union.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticised Donald Trump for calling Vladimir Putin a friend and said delays in delivering anti-ballistic missiles were costing lives.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz threatened to veto the European Union budget unless all member states support a forty-five billion euro loan for Ukraine for two thousand and twenty-seven.

background.text: The International Olympic Committee previously ended its recommendation that Russian athletes compete only as neutrals without their flag or anthems.
Russia has been increasing its use of unconventional warfare, employing sabotage, reconnaissance and intimidation against European countries.
A new survey by the Körber Foundation showed that for the first time, Kyiv no longer enjoys majority support among the German population.

matters.text: Analysts suggest that Russia's unconventional war on Europe has failed in its strategic purpose because military assistance to Ukraine from Western allies continues to increase.
Vladyslav Heraskevych warned that blanket sports bans could have a huge effect on Olympic qualifying events in Europe.
Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned that an attack sinking a Russian warship risked spreading war to the Mediterranean.

uncertain.text: Zelensky revealed that it was not clear whether European negotiators would be at the table for upcoming peace talks.
Zelensky stated that it remained unknown whether satellite communications restrictions were a technical decision by SpaceX or a political one.

terms.definition: The supreme organisation of the Olympic movement responsible for governing the Olympic Games.
An international quasi-judicial body established to settle disputes related to sport through arbitration.

problems: Friedrich Merz is identified as German Chancellor, but the current Chancellor is Olaf Scholz.
The text mentions an attack sinking a Russian warship without explaining the event or its context.
The text introduces Vladyslav Heraskevych without identifying his role or relevance to the narrative.

Israeli strikes kill 16 schoolchildren so far this month, Gaza ministry says

explained.headline: Amnesty International accuses Israel of trying to destroy life in Gaza

happened.text: Amnesty International stated that Israel has sought to prevent births in Gaza by repeatedly targeting women and girls.
The rights group reported that Israeli forces killed about 30 women and girls daily since October 2023.
Separately, Gaza's ministry of education stated that Israeli strikes killed at least 16 schoolchildren in the territory since the start of November.

background.text: Amnesty International is a human rights organisation whose secretary general is Agnes Callamard.
The conflict has involved extensive destruction of medical and educational infrastructure, leaving thousands of children unable to attend school regularly.
The Israel Defense Forces stated that it carries out operations while taking measures to mitigate harm to civilians.

matters.text: Amnesty International said that killings, forced displacement, starvation and healthcare disruptions formed part of a deliberate drive to prevent Palestinian population growth.
Agnes Callamard called on the International Criminal Court to examine gender-based crimes within its ongoing investigation into alleged war crimes.

uncertain.text: The Israel Defense Forces stated that there was not enough information to comment on specific incidents involving young people.
Amnesty International noted that the blockade on the Gaza Strip caused an untold number of additional female deaths.

terms.definition: An intergovernmental organisation and international tribunal that prosecutes individuals for genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes and the crime of aggression.
A United Nations agency responsible for providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide.

problems: The text mentions 'the blockade' without providing any background or context explaining what it is.
